title: About
text:
Our Mission



Innovation First
We believe in pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with AI and developer tools. Our platform enables creators to build applications that think, learn, and adapt.


Developer Experience
Great tools should feel invisible. We obsess over every detail of the developer experience, from intuitive APIs to comprehensive documentation.


Open Collaboration
The best ideas come from diverse perspectives. We’re building a community where developers can share, learn, and create together.


Ethical AI
With great power comes great responsibility. We’re committed to building AI systems that are transparent, fair, and beneficial to all.

title: Home
text:
We're converging on San Francisco for Actuate 2025, see you there!Learn More

















We’re building the perception platform for robotics.



We started at MIT, uncovering how humans perceive the world. We pioneered GPU-powered algorithms that rival state-of-the-art vision models, and then discovered mechanisms of nueral computation. In a parallel universe, early Stripe engineers were honing a culture of obsessive focus on user experience, AI infra, and scalable platforms. Now we’ve brought those worlds together into Perceptual, the next-gen perception platform for robotics.

title: Home
text:
Our Ethos

We began with a vision to reimagine perception for autonomous systems. In a world where robots and AI agents are becoming increasingly sophisticated, we believe the fundamental challenge isn’t just processing power or algorithms—it’s understanding the world the way humans do.
Our platform bridges the gap between raw sensor data and meaningful action. We’re building technology that doesn’t just see, but comprehends; that doesn’t just detect, but understands context and intent.
We envision a future where autonomous systems work seamlessly alongside humans, where robots can navigate complex environments with intuition and grace, and where the barrier between digital perception and human understanding dissolves. This isn’t about replacing human judgment—it’s about amplifying it, creating systems that extend our capabilities and free us to focus on what matters most: creativity, strategy, and human connection.
At Perceptual, we’re not just building better computer vision. We’re crafting the sensory foundation for the next generation of intelligent machines.
